package.name: cobot_tasks
package.description: Task manager — owns WHAT the system is doing. Hosts a registry of modular workflows (cobot_tasks/workflows/: pick_layer, calibration, ...), runs one at a time by sending action goals to cobot_operation / cobot_control and service calls to the vision nodes, lists them on /task/workflows for the dashboard, and publishes the single source of operational truth on /task/status. Dependency rule: rclpy + cobot_interfaces ONLY — this node never computes geometry and never touches motoman/camera code.
